review: stacksort-review-r1 (A QUALIFIED_PASS, B PASS, C QUALIFIED_PASS, D PASS bounded, E QUALIFIED_PASS; PROCEED with conditions)

rulings.fidelity: agree: the source Definition 1.1 (average multiplicity) governs; Conjecture 4.4 appears in v3/v4 and as EJC Conjecture 23 (v1/v2 carry only a (1.6, 1.8) remark). The MathDB 'maximum fiber' paraphrase is refuted trivially and earns no credit on its own; the Lean packet must still cover it cheaply.
rulings.endpoint: REQUIRED: ¬Conj (literal existential), the stronger form ∀ L, Tendsto → 1.73 ≤ L, and a non-vacuity companion (∃ᶠ n, 1.73 < d_n^(1/n), via an explicit subsequence); plus the maximum-fibre reading.
rulings.significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, moderate: a genuine refutation of a published EJC conjecture restated as open by Defant (Adv. Math. 2022); no prior computation beyond 1.62924. The reviewer's adversarial point (exact P_1..P_13 plus a new elementary root-split inequality already suffice) lowers depth but not validity: the refutation needs exact data never published plus a new inequality, matching the campaign's accepted pattern of exact search just beyond the source's range. The exact polynomial-time recursion, the proven bound above 1.80 and the estimate of about 1.95 are additions.
rulings.route: review route L1-L7: literal s and deg; order-equivariance; the doubling injection C(2a,a) P_a^2 <= P_(2a+1); the series-free iteration invariant; the elementary root-split inequality; exact seeds P_1..P_16 or P_1..P_20 from a proved top-max recursion on tuples of words; kernel evaluation of about 70k big-integer operations. Avoid kernel evaluation of P_50 or P_78.

decision: PROCEED to Lean formalisation (stacksort-formal-r1, Sol); manuscript must correct the version history and temper the 'new formula is essential' claim
